_comment: Settings for tools/nexus/build_modpack.py. Change the counts to grow or shrink the pack, then rerun the builder.
patch25DateNote: Mods whose main file was uploaded on/after this date are treated as updated for 2.5 (CET's 2.5 build shipped 2026-10-22).
scriptCutoffNote: redscript / CET / TweakXL mods older than this (patch 2.3) are skipped. Newer ones are kept but marked 'verify'.
assetCutoffNote: Archive-only mods older than this (patch 2.1) are skipped; 2.0/2.1 changed too much for them to be safe.
excludeOutdatedNativeNote: Skip RED4ext / ASI plugins whose main file predates 2.5 (they're the mods most likely to crash a new patch). Ignored for mods pulled in as someone else's requirement.

excludeModIdsNotes.13485: 4x Vending Machine Framework: world-sector edits fail on 2.5 (ArchiveXL: node count mismatch). Seen in user logs 2026-11-13.
excludeModIdsNotes.16256: 4x Magazine Framework: world-sector edits fail on 2.5 (ArchiveXL: node count mismatch). Seen in user logs 2026-11-13.
excludeModIdsNotes.12874: Dogtown Location Visuals Nulled: world-sector edits fail on 2.5 (node type mismatch). Mods requiring it are dropped too.

skippedNexusCategoriesNote: Not pulled in automatically. Requirements from these categories still get added.
